title: Interview loop tactics + headcount prep (1:1 scratch)
content:
TL;DR: Prep notes for 1:1 with Sam (eng manager) — align on headcount ask for Q2, tighten interview loop to reduce time-to-hire, fix candidate handover friction, and establish clear debrief expectations. Quick ask: 15–20 min sync + follow-up doc by Friday.

Meeting goals
- Decide whether to move forward with formal HC request for +2 SWE ICs on Serving Runtime (priority: GPU scheduling path).
- Agree concrete changes to loop to cut average scheduling latency from 12 -> 7 days.
- Capture owner/action items for interviewer calibration and recruiter handoff.

Context (notes to self)
- Team load: Serving Runtime has a 9% capacity gap vs roadmap (from ENG-ops spreadsheet). Current plan assumes hiring 2 ICs by end of Q2.
- Budget cue: Finance said we have 1.8 FTE-equivalent left vs committed plan; going above requires VP approval.
- Interview funnel leak: 28% drop between onscreen take-home and final onsites — suspected cause: unclear take-home instructions + inconsistent scoring rubric.

Proposed headcount ask (what I'll present)
- Role: Senior SWE (Latency/Runtime) x2, 100% IC focus, start window Jun–Jul.
- Justification bullets: critical infra features (GPU packing, KV cache persistence), current oncall risks + blocked PRs (see PR list), projected 10% throughput gain if staffed.
- Plan B: if quota denied, propose 1 contractor key hire (3–6 months) + prioritize roadmap to stretch capacity.

Interview loop changes I want agreement on
1) Take-home -> Structured code review: trim TO from open-ended proj to 2 x mini tasks (45m) + checklist. Make rubric explicit (correctness, design, edge cases, readability).
2) Replace separate system-design hour with a 30-min focused runtime question + 30-min troubleshooting exercise (faster and more predictive for this role).
3) Interviewer guide: single-page cheat-sheet for expected signals by level (SWE3, SWE4), posted in GH gist and linked on scheduler.
4) Debriefs: mandatory 15-min structured debrief within 48h of onsite; use the template below.

Debrief template (one-liner + scores) — propose adopting as default
- Candidate: name / role / date
- Strengths (3 bullets)
- Risks (3 bullets)
- Score 1–5 on: Technical depth, System design fit, Ownership/collaboration, Hiring bar (overall)
- Recommendation: Strong yes / Yes / No / Hold (with reason)

Candidate experience fixes (immediate ops changes)
- Clear timeline email after phone screen: include expected loop duration, contacts + panel names, travel reimburse policy. Recruiter to send within 24h.
- Scheduler: block buffer between interviews (10m) + explicit interviewer cancellation policy to avoid day-of changes.
- Feedback to candidates: recruiter to send outcome note within 48h of final decision (template provided).

Data to bring to 1:1
- Funnel metrics last 90 days (rejection step breakdown) — see attached Confluence chart.
- List of current candidates in pipeline + highest-risk slots (2 folks in take-home).
- PRs blocked by staffing: PR#342, PR#358 (short notes).

Questions I want Sam to answer (during 1:1)
- Priority: if we get only 1 HC, which hiring profile should we prioritize — infra depth or general perf?
- Are managers willing to trade off some feature velocity to help with oncall gap? (i.e., slower feature rollout to free senior time for mentoring)
- Will you commit interviewers to the new debrief timeline and the one-page guide? If not, why?

Risks / pushbacks I expect + how I'll rebut
- Finance says no room: pushback: show tradeoffs (contractor vs hire), call out lost-opportunity costs (SLO misses).
- Managers worry about interviewer time: propose rotating interviewer roster and a reduced loop (one fewer panel) as alternate.
- Concerns about speed vs signal: show data correlating our truncated loop with better pipeline — bring one quick case study (Platform team).

Action items (what I want to leave the 1:1 with)
- Sam: verbal yes/no on submitting formal HC request by Tue 3/16.
- Me: send updated loop guide + debrief template to recruiters + all interviewers by Wed.
- Sam: confirm 3 interviewers who will commit to 48h debrief windows.
- Recruiter (Aisha): start revised take-home process for next two candidates (pilot).

Notes-to-self (follow-ups after sync)
- Draft HC justification doc: include PR callouts and impact calc (time-saved per token). Tag finance and VP.
- Create GH gist: interviewer one-pager + post to #eng-hiring and link in scheduler.
- Add JIRA ticket for updating candidate email templates (owner: recruiter).
- Track: set a calendar cadence to revisit funnel metrics every 2 weeks for next 8 weeks.

Open questions (for offline)
- Can we fast-track relocation/visa approvals if candidate is high-priority? Who signs?
- Is there a budget remap possible from Optimize to Infrastructure for Q2? Need Finance contact.

Misc scratch / shorthand
- "runtime packing" = higher perf priority; flag in JD.
- Ask Sam if he'd be ok with 2-week onsite windows (group scheduling) to reduce panel fragmentation.

End of scratch. Keep this doc as working draft; rename to final HC request once approved.
